title: А. Рабочий лист
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity desktop web app design concept image, 1600x1100 landscape, Russian interface, for existing educational app Запоминальня. This is a practical logged-in tool, not a landing page. Reference screenshot supplies palette, typography, sidebar spacing ONLY; replace its main area completely. Common style: white/off-white paper, deep ink #172229, royal-blue #284BB2 controls, pale blue selected #E9EFFF, hairline #D9DFEC borders, extremely restrained shadows, 12px corners. Georgia regular 44px page heading, sans-serif 22px section headings, sans-serif 16px controls/body, 14px muted metadata. Plenty of breathing room, crisp readable Russian typesetting. Fixed left nav approx 230px: text-only wordmark "Запоминальня" (DO NOT invent or redraw mascot/logo), items "Главная", "Материалы", "ИИ-помощник" selected, "Практика", "Классы", "Достижения", "Тариф", "Настройки"; bottom "Александр" and theme control. Main starts x280. Eyebrow "ИИ-помощник", H1 "Что будем изучать?", subtitle "Загрузите материалы — получите понятный конспект и карточки." Same demo data everywhere: "Лекция о клетке.mp3" with "Аудио · 42 мин" and "Строение клетки.pdf" with "Документ · 18 страниц". Two sources already attached; show "2 файла добавлено", no invented numeric subscription caps. Small understated link "Лимиты тарифа". Result options EXACT "Конспект" selected, "Конспект и карточки", "Карточки", subordinate text action "Только расшифровка". Course destination options "В новый курс" selected / "В существующий курс", field label "Название курса", value "Биология клетки", helper "Конспект станет первым уроком курса." Collapsed "Дополнительные настройки". Primary action "Создать конспект". No URLs, no chat prompt composer, no AI chat bubbles, no pricing upsell banners, no output transcript or reading screen. Bottom history heading "Последние задачи", quiet thin-divider rows "Основы генетики" / "Конспект и карточки · Сегодня" / "Готово" and "Клеточное дыхание" / "Конспект · Вчера" / "Готово". Small blue ballpoint-pen illustration of paper/waveform/flashcards is allowed, restrained yellow paper accent, never behind text. Everything coherent and usable, no concept labels outside application.
LAYOUT A: One centered large white workbook panel max1060px, simple vertical flow. Within panel: broad SHALLOW upload area at top, dashed border, label "Добавьте материалы", small outline upload icon at left, blue pen sketch of audio/document at far right; horizontal two attached file chips below with remove x and "+ Добавить файлы". Next "Что создать" with 3 equal single-choice tiles horizontally, small muted transcription link. Then single horizontal course destination row and title input, helper below. Bottom divider, collapsed additional settings left, strong primary action right. A single clear hierarchy, form all visible in one viewport, heading and panel both aligned. History two compact rows below. Avoid nested cards around every label.
